analysis.title: Nvidia Earnings Preview: Everything You Need To Know About The First Print Without Jensen
key_insights: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 at 4:20pm ET on Nov 17, 2026, with a call at 5pm, under interim CEO Colette Kress less than a week after Jensen Huang resigned.
The stock is down roughly 35% from its early October all-time high and has shed about $2 trillion in market cap since mid-October.

The main debate is next year, not the quarter: whether Kress repeats the guide of revenue growth above 70% for next fiscal year. BofA puts 10-15% odds on guidance being pulled until a permanent CEO is named.
Consensus Q3 revenue is $109.3B against company guidance of $108B, with Data Center at $101.9B, adjusted gross margin of 74.0% and adjusted EPS of $2.47.

Goldman's Jim Schneider expects a solid Q3 and a Q4 guide above the Street, driven by margins. His Q3/Q4 EPS estimates are both 6% above the Street, and the gap comes from gross and operating margin, not revenue.

JPMorgan's spec sales survey puts buyside Q3 revenue at $112.6B, $3.5B above the Street, with EPS of $2.63 and a Q4 revenue guide of $129.1B against a $124.4B consensus. The buyside bar is higher than sellside consensus.

UBS's Tim Arcuri expects a Q3 revenue beat of $3-4B (about $111-112B) and a Q4 guide near $130B against a $125B consensus. He calls the selloff a buying opportunity but cut his C2028 estimates and price target.

Options imply a move of about 8% (7.95% per UBS), the largest implied move in two years. 1-month implied vol is the highest heading into a print since March 2025, and 3-month vol is above 50% from the low 30s in early October.
In eight of the last ten quarters the stock moved less than options priced. Average implied move was 7.7% against an average realized 4.8%. Last quarter implied was 5.9% and the stock moved 8.7%.
JPMorgan's equity vol team says dealer gamma and skew hedging flows are fading, and recommends avoiding short gamma into the print.
Levered ETFs saw $5.2B of outflows (SOXL lost $3.7B) while NVDL took in about $0.7B. Retail has been getting cold feet after record opening-bid buying the day Huang left.
The stock trades below 12x forward earnings, the lowest multiple in 13 years per Morgan Stanley, while fiscal 2028 EPS estimates have barely moved from their highs per Goldman.

SemiAnalysis cut its 2028 accelerator spending forecast by 28%, mostly attributed to Nvidia. UBS cut C2028 revenue to $885B from $985B, EPS to $20.01 from $22.08, and its price target to $240 from $300.
JPMorgan says reiterating capex and support for existing financing deals is critical to the bull case, and a failure to reassure on AI ecosystem financing tops its bear case.

Washington closed the cloud loophole on AI chip rentals to China, new export rules cover Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia, and the board created a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee. Treasury Secretary Bessent reportedly wants an outsider as CEO.

Deutsche Bank's Jim Reid: Nvidia earns about $240B on a rolling four-quarter basis, and consensus has $625B by 2031. At that figure the stock trades at about 6x 2031 earnings, and 16x would make it a $10 trillion company.
The author expects the beat and buyback, a 70% reaffirmation with export-rule qualifiers, and a move larger than 8%, probably down first.

market_movers.rationale: Goldman expects a beat on profitability and a Q4 guide above the Street, with EPS 6% above consensus for both quarters.
UBS's Arcuri lowered his price target to $240 from $300 on Southeast Asia risk but calls the selloff an attractive buying opportunity.

earnings_insights: NVDA fiscal Q3, reports 11/17 after close (consensus, not yet reported at writing): revenue $109.3B vs company guide $108B, Data Center $101.9B, adjusted gross margin 74.0%, adjusted EPS $2.47.

Goldman Q3 adjusted EPS estimate $2.57 vs Street $2.42 (the text also cites a Street figure of $2.47 and JPMorgan cites $2.48). Q4 EPS estimate $2.88 vs Street $2.73. Gross margin estimate 74.1% vs 73.1% for Q3 and 72.2% vs 71.5% for Q4.
JPMorgan spec sales buyside survey (estimate, not reported): Q3 revenue $112.6B, EPS $2.63 vs Street $2.48, Q4 revenue guide $129.1B vs $124.4B consensus, gross margin 74.2% Q3 and 72.0% Q4 guide.

UBS estimate: Q3 revenue beat of $3-4B, potentially $111-112B, and Q4 guide near $130B vs a consensus UBS pegs at $125B. UBS sees little gross margin risk after the 71-72% guide, with margins recovering from fiscal Q1.
Last quarter's share repurchase was $20B, which Goldman's desk uses as the yardstick for capital returns this quarter.
Prior commentary guided CY27 revenue growth above 70%, and investors want it reiterated.

trade_ideas.description: Avoid short gamma into NVDA earnings
trade_ideas.rationale: Hedging flows are fading, so the next move depends on the surprise rather than mechanical flows.

risk_factors: Guidance could be pulled until a permanent CEO is named (BofA: 10-15%).
Export rules and China regulatory risk.
Failure to reassure on AI ecosystem financing and the circular deals.
Retention of key engineers and culture under a new CEO.
Buyside whisper numbers sit well above sellside consensus.
vol_and_positioning: Implied earnings move about 8% (7.95% per UBS), the largest in two years and the richest since February 2025.
1-month implied vol is the highest heading into a print since March 2025. 3-month vol is above 50% from the low 30s in early October.
UBS notes SPX options price Wednesday as the largest one-day move for the rest of the year.
JPMorgan equity vol: less dealer gamma and lower skew, little fear of another large drop, avoid short gamma into the print.
Levered ETFs had $5.2B of outflows, SOXL lost $3.7B, and NVDL took in about $0.7B.
Average implied move over the last ten quarters was 7.7% against 4.8% realized, and realized was below implied in eight of ten.
geopolitical: US closed the cloud loophole on AI chip rentals to China.
New export rules cover Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia.
Reported push by China hawks (led by Rubio, per a JPMorgan note) to shut exports to China, with Trump under pressure to out-hawk the hawks.
Treasury Secretary Bessent has told the board he wants an outsider as CEO.
cross_bank_references: Goldman is above consensus on EPS while its revenue forecasts are within 1% of consensus.
UBS's Arcuri is described by the bank's trading desk as increasingly contrarian.

tension_points.bull_case: Consensus has NVDA earnings reaching $625B by 2031, which is about 6x 2031 earnings at the current price. A 16x multiple would make it a $10 trillion company (Deutsche Bank's Reid).
tension_points.bear_case: A stock does not trade at 6x a forecast it believes. SemiAnalysis cut 2028 accelerator spend by 28% and UBS cut C2028 estimates on Southeast Asia risk.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The interim CEO declining to reaffirm the 70%+ revenue growth guide for next year, or guidance being pulled until a permanent CEO is named.

tension_points.bull_case: Options sellers have collected easy money, with realized moves below implied in eight of ten quarters. Goldman and UBS expect a beat, and positioning has cleaned up.
tension_points.bear_case: The buyside bar ($112.6B revenue, $129.1B Q4 guide) is above sellside consensus, so an ordinary beat may not be enough. Last quarter implied was 5.9% and the stock moved 8.7%.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A Q3 revenue print or Q4 guide that falls short of the buyside whisper ($112.6B and about $129B).

theme_stances.key_argument: An interim CEO cannot credibly promise 2028, the checkbook staying open, or what Washington allows Nvidia to ship.
theme_stances.evidence: a temp in the corner office can't credibly promise 2028
